title: Agent Analyzer upload manifest, format v1
description: Sent by the plugin CLI with POST /api/runs, before the upload. Describes the one gzipped tar that follows (projects/<project>/<session>.jsonl plus <session>/subagents/). A new field or meaning is a new format_version.

tool.description: The agentic tool whose history is uploaded; selects the server-side reader.

window.description: The history window the client collected, in the client's local dates.

session_count.description: Sessions in the upload, subagent transcripts not counted separately.

bytes.description: Contract ceilings; the server may enforce lower limits (see server/README.md).

compressed.description: Exact size of the .tar.gz the client will PUT.

uncompressed.description: Total size of the files inside the tar.
